question: Add a new method AppendCTZeroSample(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t, ct int64) (SeriesRef, error) to the Appender interface in prometheus/storage. Appender is used by all components that write time-series data including remote write receivers, OTLP-to-Prometheus converters, and Mimir distributors. All implementations must add this method.

interface_definition.method_to_add: AppendCTZeroSample(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t, ct int64) (SeriesRef, error)
interface_definition.note: This method follows the same pattern as the existing AppendSTZeroSample in StartTimestampAppender. CT stands for Created Timestamp (vs ST = Start Timestamp). Adding this to the Appender interface would require a new embedded interface (e.g., CreatedTimestampAppender) or direct inclusion.
